mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned primary silver mine near Cobar, NSW. Built, permitted ~1 Mtpa processing facility with camp (expanding to 118 persons), power, water and infrastructure. Ore Reserve 12.8 Moz Ag underpinning initial production plan (per 13 Jul 2026 announcement); Mineral Resource 51 Moz Ag (per 1 Apr 2021) with growth/mine-life extension potential. 10-year mine plan: ~19 Moz Ag from Wonawinta (average EBITDA ~A$127M, NPV8 ~A$805M at very high A$135.50/oz silver assumption; IRR ~1092% - note exceptional price assumption). Gold processing (Mt Boppy ore) recommenced 21 Aug 2026; silver production targeted Q4 2026 after de-slime circuit installation; ramp-up >1 Mtpa comprising 65-70,000 t Ag/mth + 20-25,000 t Au/mth. Executive Chairman Dennis Karp (since 2016); Exec Director Alan Eggers; NE Director John Seton; Executive GM Rod Griffith. 100%-owned gold mine near Canbelego, NSW (one of NSW's historically richest gold mines: ~500,000 oz Au @ ~15 g/t produced historically). Total resource 2.6 Mt @ 1.32 g/t Au; open-pit Probable Ore Reserve 290 kt @ 4.2 g/t = 39 koz Au. >50,000 t of gold-bearing ore stockpiled at Wonawinta for processing. Feeding the initial gold restart; ~46 koz Au expected from Mt Boppy + stockpiles over 10-yr plan. Open-pit drilling program targeting ~40,000 oz Au resource addition; deeps drilling underway targeting additional high-grade pods. Mt Boppy deeps have strong potential as typical Cobar Basin style Pb-Zn-Ag project. No royalties or streaming. [production_notes: Ore supplied to Wonawinta for gold processing from 21 Aug 2026; ~50-60,000 t stockpiled initially, targeting 125-140,000 t processed over three months.] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: Ore hauled ~150 km by road to Wonawinta for processing; no standalone cost disclosure.]
